subject: dxf: rename the pkg from "disttask" to "dxf" (#65396)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent focusing on `pkg/ddl` add-index backfilling / distributed scheduler wiring, `pkg/meta` scheduler-status integration, and `pkg/dxf` task framework/storage. The changes in-scope are mechanical path updates (`pkg/disttask/...` -> `pkg/dxf/...`) with no observed functional/metadata/state-machine logic changes; e.g. DXF task storage continues to use the same system tables (`mysql.tidb_global_task`, `mysql.tidb_background_subtask`, and history tables). Checked later history up to `upstream/master` for these areas and saw no follow-up revert/fix indicating a rename-introduced correctness regression.
